description: Sign in to Telegram and let agents list conversations and read bounded recent history. Sending is disabled in this slice.
configHelp: Install the pinned tg v0.11.0 release into the plugin-owned runtime directory with `node telegram-client/scripts/install-tg.cjs` from the codeterm-plugins checkout. Open the Telegram Client view, enter your own Telegram API ID and API hash from my.telegram.org, and start QR login. Agent verbs: `accounts`; `use <account-id>`; `chats`; `history <chat-id> [n]`; `health`; `logout`. `send` and `preview` return an explicit refusal because sending is not enabled in this slice. History is capped at 50 messages and 32 KiB. API credentials are stored with host.secretSet and supplied in process environment, never arguments. The app_hash is also persisted by tg in its mode-0600 YAML config. On macOS sessions use the login Keychain; other platforms store a mode-0600 session file inside this plugin's private runtime directory.
